req.title: Support all HTTP verbs on /status/<code>
req.statement: The system shall accept GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS, and TRACE on /status/<code>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /status/<code> endpoint must support all HTTP verbs and return a 2xx response for valid requests. Tests are designed to cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure compliance with the requirement and robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_status_code_get_200
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/status/200')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_status_code_invalid_method
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
expected: The response status code is 405 (Method Not Allowed).
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.open('/status/200', method='CONNECT')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_status_code_boundary_299
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/status/299')
assert response.status_code == 299
